steps.text: Make sure that as many items above are prepared as possible
Head south to Tai Bwo Wannai (or use a Brimhaven house teleport and run south if you have them)
Talk to Timfraku, who is located upstairs in the western hut north of Tai Bwo Wannai., wait, then
Use a Brimhaven house teleport or simply run north to Lubufu by the fishing spots south of the Player Owned House portal
Talk to Lubufu.
Talk to Lubufu again.
chat: 3. I could help collect the bait.
1. You sound like you could do with the help.

steps.text: Talk to him again and give him 20 raw karambwanji.
Talk to him again.
chat: 3. What do you use to catch Karambwan?
2. What do you do with your Karambwan?

steps.text: Wait, then accept his gift and learn how to fish Karambwan.
Drop the karambwan vessel he gave you and get another, load it with a raw karambwanji then pick up the first one.
chat: 3. Actually, I've lost my Karambwan vessel.

steps.text: Drop this vessel as well, and talk to Lubufu once more to obtain a vessel for use after the quest.
chat: 3. Actually, I've lost my Karambwan vessel.

steps.text: Head to DKP - it is south of Musa point.
Grab the seaweed nearby if you don't have one already
Talk to Tiadeche, who is directly north-east of the fairy ring DKP.
Use your Raw karambwanji on the Karambwan vessel. Then use the baited Karambwan vessel on Tiadeche.
Ironmen: Fish and cook a karambwan until you get a poison karambwan. Use your pestle and mortar on it to create poison karambwan paste, then use that paste on your spear to make a Spear(kp).
Use the fairy ring right next to you and use the code CKR - it's north-west of Shilo village, south of the lake between Shilo village and Tai Bwo Wannai village.
Run north-east to the mine. Talk to Tamayu twice and watch a cutscene.
Right click and use your Agility potion (4 dose) and Spear (kp) on him - make sure he takes both.
Talk to him again, watch the cutscene. Make sure he kills the beast or you won't finish the quest,
chat: 3. Take me on your next hunt for the Shaikahan.

steps.text: Kill a monkey in this area with magic or ranged, take its corpse.
Use the corpse on Tamayu.
Use your seaweed on the monkey skin to get a seaweed sandwich.
Either run south-west or use another fairy ring teleport to go back to CKR.
Climb up the hill and cross the bridge onto Cairn Isle, WALK across the bridge.

Talk to Tinsay and hand him all the food he requests whenever prompted. (He will ask for the Rum with a banana, a “seaweed in monkey skin sandwich” which is just the seaweed sandwich, and the marinated Jogre bones that you previously created. *DO NOT BURY THEM*
After handing him the marinated j' bones, use your empty (or filled) karambwan vessel on him and you'll receive a crafting manual.
Head to fairy ring DKP.
Talk to Tiadeche, use your manual on him and he will agree to go back to the village (but he'll stay for now).
Either use a Brimhaven House teleport, fairy ring CKR or simply walk back to the quest start.
Talk to Timfraku and finish the quest.
(Optional) Before leaving, talk to Tiadeche in the south-western house in Tai Bwo Wannai for 5,000 Fishing experience.
(Optional) Before leaving, talk to Tinsay in the middle southern house in Tai Bwo Wannai for the ability to cook karambwans and to receive 5,000 Cooking experience.
(Optional) Before leaving, talk to Tamayu in the south-eastern house in Tai Bwo Wannai to receive a karambwan-poisoned rune spear, as well as 2,500 Attack and Strength experience.
Congratulations, quest complete!
